review: v299 oats, oat seed and rooted oat plot original art — independent static review

scope.rootSnapshot: /workspace/ashveil, v299 work in progress at the recorded file hashes
whatWasChecked: 3 sheet/frame additions and every old manifest value
All 529 baseline public files, existing license files and append-only CREDITS
Raw item/terrain sprite bindings, actual renderer scale/anchor source and preserved shared consumers
CC0 source declarations and disclosed generic helper/palette reuse
scope.executionBoundary: Only small standard-library Python file/pixel/JSON/SHA reads and the two isolated generators' read-only --check branches. No supplied generator/checker was imported by the independent PNG/SVG decoder.
notExecuted: Core simulation or Def DB loading
scope.mutableRootWarning: This report is tied to the recorded individual hashes. It does not claim all of mutable Root equals v298, or that subsequent v299 changes are reviewed.
scope.originalMetadataWarning: integrationApplied:false and not-yet-copied prose in isolated source documents describe the artist's earlier handoff. Root copies/raw art bindings were separately checked here.

verified: 8 PNGs contain valid IHDR/IDAT/IEND chunks with CRCs, one terminal IEND, exact RGBA8 scanline lengths and no trailing compressed/file data.
3 native PNG/SVG pairs match every RGBA component. 3 small PNGs exactly match source pixel (2x+1,2y+1). Both contact sheets match independently composed 270,336 pixels.

31 source files are accounted for by the two inventories. Root has 30 exact copies, with the oat item document as the only exact-suffix/prefix-added exception. Both LICENSE files are preserved byte-for-byte at distinct tools/art destinations.
All 529 old public files remain byte-identical. Root public count is 544 with exactly 15 additions belonging to these packs.
Every old manifest value is preserved; the only additions are 3 sheets and 3 matching 32x32 frames. Sheet/frame totals are 115/800.
12 existing LICENSE-named files in the reviewed baseline scope are byte-identical. The complete previous CREDITS.md is an exact prefix of the new CREDITS.md.

Oats and OatSeed raw definitions remain misc with no food object. The two item art replacements only change /sprite. Existing oatmeal recipe/cooked food definitions are retained; the art does not establish raw-grain eating.
The old mushrooms frame/sheet, all 8 raw consumers and the other 7 consumers' existing patch sequences are preserved. AshBerryBush already uses its prior separate original art patch.
qualifications: Root chooses OatPlot base scale .5 and omits the old tint. Artist .65 is an un-applied recommendation; contact-sheet right column is a rounded 19px reduction, not an actual renderer capture.

The renderer's .6 immature multiplier makes Root's nominal growing frame 9.6x9.6 world pixels, with an 8.1x8.4 opaque envelope. Readability at this actual fractional size still needs a later Native review.

16px item/plot reviews retain distinct silhouettes but thin stems, small ears and patch details are reduced. Art does not encode stack quantities, growth completion, freshness, safety, contamination or guaranteed yield.

oat-cultivation.json also contains game-rule and descriptive WIP operations. Those were read to separate the 2 art operations from 3 behavior/text operations; this report does not validate their behavior.

The artist's old manifest SHA matches immutable v298 and intentionally differs from Root after the 3 additions; this is a historical reference snapshot, not a failed copy or claim of unchanged current manifest.

CC0 and newly authored geometry claims are supported by the supplied license/source disclosures and inspected deterministic coordinate code. This is not an exhaustive comparison against all external artwork or a legal title investigation.

sourceInspection.observedReads: Only the generator's own bytes, its included reference-contract JSON and existing output bytes inside --check; no preexisting game PNG/SVG or model output is read as a drawing input.
sourceInspection.geometry: Item functions drooping_husk/loose_kernel/oats/oat_seed and plot functions ear/plot contain explicit new polygon/line/point coordinates. Plot geometry uses newly written ears/roots/soil/stems and does not call or import the item geometry.
sourceInspection.genericHelperReuse: AST-equivalent Canvas, rgba, png, svg, preview16 and encoded_json helpers are shared between these two packs. This reuse is disclosed; their geometry functions are separate.
sourceInspection.paletteReuse: The two 18-entry palette JSONs are byte-identical (SHA c4ef8fbfff9f395b4a75c439b4a164c554dc143296088972d9d9365c0c64874c). Reuse of this workflow's own CC0 tools/material colors is explicitly disclosed in both licenses and documents.
sourceInspection.noOriginalityOverclaim: The review verifies the supplied drawing path and disclosures; it does not infer that any palette color or generic drawing algorithm is unique.

credits.appendOnlyText:
### 직접 제작 귀리·씨앗 원본

귀리 알곡과 씨앗 주머니2종의 정수 좌표 원본을 직접 제작했다. CC0-1.0 [라이선스](tools/art/oat-LICENSE.txt) · [제작·재현·검토 자료](docs/art-oat-originals.md). 32px PNG/SVG와16px검토본을함께보관하며기존외부저작자표기는유지한다.

귀리밭 원본1종도 직접 새 정수 도형으로 제작했다. CC0-1.0 [별도라이선스](tools/art/oat-plot-LICENSE.txt) · [제작·재현 자료](docs/art-oat-plot-original.md). 기존 그늘 작물·버섯·외부 제작자 표기는 유지한다.

data.label: 그늘 작물 밭
data.description: 검은 잎 사이로 먹을 수 있는 뿌리가 자란다. 수확 뒤 하루가 지나면 다시 자란다.

data.label: 양배추 밭
data.description: 심은 씨앗에서 잎채소가 자란다. 재생산 속도는 현재 콘텐츠 기본값이다.

data.label: 잿딸기 덤불
data.description: 여름에만 열매가 열린다. 채집 뒤 새 열매를 기다려야 한다.

data.label: 버섯 무리
data.description: 장막 포자를 먹고 자란 버섯. 뒤지면 먹을 만한 갓버섯이 있다. 따 가도 이틀이면 다시 돋는다.

data.label: 흰갓 배양목
data.description: 목재 배지에서 어둠을 좋아하는 흰갓버섯이 자란다. 햇빛20% 이하, 실제 물과5~35°C가 필요하다. 네 번 수확하면 실제 목재로 배지를 교체해야 한다.

op.value: 저조도에 적응한 여러해살이 뿌리 작물. 새로 심은 밭은 실제 햇빛·기온·관수에 따라 자라고 수확 뒤 다시 자란다.
저조도에 적응한 여러해살이 뿌리 작물. 실제 햇빛·기온·관수에 따라 자란다. 지상 토양 밭끼리 남은 물을 천천히 나누며, 이미 작물에 옮은 오염은 원래 밭에 남는다.

rawIntegration.boundary: Raw JSON operations and source rendering arithmetic only; no patch engine/Def DB/game execution.

rawOperations.value: 실제 귀리 종자에서 자란 밭. 새로 심으면 실제 햇빛15% 이상·0~35°C와 관수가 필요하다. 유효 성장5일 뒤5묶음을 수확하며 원래 관수 오염은 곡물에 남는다. 기존 옛 밭의 수확 시각은 유지한다.
비어 있는 흙에 심는 실제 귀리 씨앗 한 개. 새 밭은 햇빛15% 이상·0~35°C·성장 주기당 실제 물1000ml가 필요하다. 비·증발과 토양 수분 이동도 적용된다.

data.label: 귀리죽 그릇
data.description: 실제 귀리와 물로 끓인 한 그릇. 다 먹으면 원래 그릇이 남는다.

data.label: 빈 그릇
data.description: 죽을 담았다가 같은 그릇을 다시 쓴다.
